title: Chris Ballard: Alec Pierce did not receive second PRP injection

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chris Ballard: Alec Pierce did not receive second PRP injection
sources.description: Colts General Manager Chris Ballard said on Tuesday that receiver Alec Pierce did not, in fact, have a second platelet-rich plasma injection to speed up the healing of his ankle, according to multiple reporters.
